contents.analysis: Aggregate result, coverage, and trajectory-scan tables derived from the release artifacts.
contents.custom_agents: Harbor agent adapters used by the provided Harbor config templates.
contents.dataset/tasks: 219 benchmark task directories with instructions, task metadata, gold source patch, and hidden test patch.
contents.pyproject.toml: Python package metadata declaring the Harbor dependency and custom agent package.
contents.repro: Helper scripts and schema notes for reproducing task image pulls, oracle-solution verification, candidate-patch verification, release validation, Harbor execution, and trajectory scanning.
contents.trajectories: Trajectory exports for the reported benchmark configurations.
contents.verify_logs: Verifier stdout/CTRF exports keyed to the trajectory rows.
